author: Argus
title: A permissionless cancel invalidates queued approvals it does not name
summary: A cancellation anyone may send advances the project generation and kills every queued approval for that project, not only the one the caller names. Work already queued by other parties silently needs re-queueing, and the cancel costs its sender nothing.

matcher.notes: cancelApproval(bytes32,uint256) 0xbca486bc, queue(Approval,bytes) 0x9fc3c7eb, execute(Approval,bytes,bytes) 0x9a17cce7, registerProject(Registration,bytes,bytes) 0xd84a83ff. selectors derived from source and ABI, membership checked against the deployed runtime

money_bound.expression: no money moves; the loss is work and the queue position of every approval for that project

reproduction.expected: a cancel sent while nothing is pending still advances the generation and an already queued approval can no longer execute
